title: Memory leak and unreadable text in Run
author: CircuitDaemon
summary: The deterministic long-query visual overlap belongs to the existing Run layout tracker. The reported 0.97.2 installation predates a shipped stale-query worker-leak fix, so a current-release memory and thread retest is needed before treating the memory report as a separate defect.

status.label: Current-release memory retest needed
status.detail: The visual issue has existing ownership, while later shipped worker-lifetime work may cover the memory symptom.

next_action.label: Request current-release Run retest
next_action.reason: Separate the known visual overlap from any persistent memory or thread growth on a build containing the later fix.

judgment.rationale: The exact query and screenshots establish the visual overlap, but the memory observation is from PowerToys 0.97.2. PR 48394 later fixed Run stale-query worker accumulation and shipped in stable 0.101.2362.0; the available diagnostics do not prove the reported memory growth used that mechanism.
evidence: The report includes an exact long query, overlap screenshots, a diagnostic archive, a text attachment, and a screenshot of high PowerToys Run memory.
Issue 13554 remains the canonical long-input autocomplete-alignment tracker.
LauncherControl.xaml overlays QueryTextBox and AutoCompleteTextBlock while the TextBox content scrolls independently.
The supplied diagnostic has no process dump, ETL, GC dump, runtime trace, thread timeline, or memory timeline.
PR 48394 fixed stale-query worker accumulation and is included in stable 0.101.2362.0; the reported installation is 0.97.2.
judgment.recommended_action: Request a current-stable repetition with thread and memory observations before, during, and after the Run interaction.

fix_assessment.rationale: PR 48394 plausibly covers the stale-query worker accumulation that could contribute to memory growth and has shipped in current stable. It does not fix the visual layout defect in Issue 13554 or prove it covered this report's memory observation.

issue_context.summary: A long mixed-character Run query visibly overlaps the autocomplete text; after repeated editing, the reporter observed severe memory growth on a version predating later query-worker lifetime work.
known_information: The report targets PowerToys 0.97.2 on Windows 11 build 26200.
The mixed-character query produces the visual overlap after one more character.
The issue includes a screenshot showing substantial memory attributed to PowerToys Run.
The diagnostic archive includes no heap or runtime trace establishing memory retention.
PR 48394 is merged and included in 0.101.2362.0.
inferences: The visual symptom is another instance of Issue 13554.
The separate stationary autocomplete surface likely contributes to the visual overlap.
The memory symptom may be covered by PR 48394, but no evidence ties this occurrence to its stale-query worker mechanism.
The visual defect and memory growth are not established as one root cause.
issue_context.analysis: The report should not be closed only as a visual duplicate because it includes a serious memory observation. A current-release timing and memory/thread comparison directly tests the later shipped coverage without inventing a second implementation plan.
initial_investigation: Read the complete issue, attached diagnostic material, and timeline.
Reviewed Issue 13554 and related duplicate history.
Inspected LauncherControl.xaml, MainWindow.xaml.cs, MainViewModel.cs, and autocomplete tests.

information_gaps.how_to_collect: Update PowerToys, record PowerToys Run memory and thread count before testing, repeat the supplied long-query edit for 10 to 15 seconds, then record them after clearing the query and about one minute after dismissing Run.

actions.label: Request current-release Run retest

comment.body: Thanks for the exact query, screenshots, log, and diagnostic ZIP. The overlapping long-input text is already tracked in #13554. The reported PowerToys 0.97.2 build predates PR #48394, which fixed PowerToys Run worker accumulation after repeated stale-query cancellation and is included in stable 0.101.2362.0. Please update to the current stable release and repeat the supplied long-query edit for 10 to 15 seconds while recording PowerToys.Run memory and thread count before testing, during repeated edits, after clearing the query, and about one minute after dismissing Run. Please also confirm whether the text overlap remains. If memory or thread counts remain elevated after dismissal, add `/bugreport` immediately after reproducing.
